items.title: Hardcover David Whyte Consolations Elizabeth Gilbert Keep This Book By Your Bedside Forever
items.description: Elizabeth Gilbert says keep this book by your bedside forever, and readers agree, awarding it a stellar 4.45 stars on Goodreads. Poet David Whyte reimagines 52 everyday words like alone, anger and forgiveness as doorways into deeper meaning, with an introduction by Maria Popova and cover praise from Nick Cave. Lemn Sissay calls it an immensely powerful, extraordinary book you will want to keep forever. A gorgeous, gift ready hardback for anyone who loves poetic nonfiction. #davidwhyte #consolations #giftbooks

items.title: Rare Markus Zusak The Book Thief NYT Called It Life Changing Number 1 International Bestseller
items.description: The New York Times called it the kind of book that can be life changing, and millions of readers agree. Narrated by Death itself, this Number 1 international bestseller follows a book stealing girl hiding a Jewish man in Nazi Germany. Translated into over 40 languages and adapted into a major 2013 film, it spent more than a decade on bestseller lists worldwide. 4.4 stars on Goodreads. #wwiifiction #bookthief #bestseller

items.title: unpredictable Keigo Higashino A Midsummers Equation Detective Galileo The Japanese Stieg Larsson
items.description: Physicist detective Manabu Yukawa travels to a struggling seaside resort town for a mining conference, only to be pulled into a murder investigation when a guest is found dead at the base of the cliffs. Kirkus called it ingenious in working one twist after another in a case that seems absolutely twist proof, and The Times dubbed Higashino the Japanese Stieg Larsson. The third book in the internationally bestselling Detective Galileo series, later adapted into a hit Japanese film. 3.96 stars on Goodreads. #japanesecrimefiction #detectivegalileo #mysterythriller

items.title: inspiring Piya Bahadur Road to Mekong Four Women 17000 Kilometres Motorcycle Adventure
items.description: Four women left their regular lives behind for fifty six days to ride motorbikes 17,000 kilometres across six countries, from Hyderabad through India's northeast, Myanmar, Thailand, Laos and Vietnam along the Mekong River to Cambodia. Piya Bahadur recounts a once in a lifetime journey through terrain rarely seen by Indian travellers, and her own transformation from an inhibited working mother into a confident adventurer. Praised by Incredible India's Director General of Tourism as an exhilarating read. #motorcycletravel #womenwhotravel #adventurememoir

items.title: Emotional Mirza Waheed The Book of Gold Leaves DSC Prize Shortlist Kashmir Love Story
items.description: A forbidden love story between a Sunni boy and Shia girl unfolds against the backdrop of 1990s Kashmir, as war and political violence close in on their world. Shortlisted for the DSC Prize for South Asian Literature and longlisted for the Folio Prize, the Financial Times called it a work that will undoubtedly endure. From the author of the international bestseller The Collaborator, praised by Arundhati Roy as fiction that makes you listen #kashmirliterature #southasianfiction #warfiction

items.title: Chitra Banerjee Divakaruni The Palace of Illusions International Bestseller Mahabharata India Retold
items.description: The timeless Mahabharata retold entirely from the perspective of Panchaali, wife of the five Pandava brothers, tracing her fiery birth, her complicated bond with Krishna, and her forbidden attraction to her husbands' most dangerous enemy. The Los Angeles Times called it a bright gem as the Hope Diamond, and the Houston Chronicle called it radiant and charming. A deeply human, half history, half myth story of a woman born into a man's world. 4.20 stars on Goodreads. #mahabharata #mythicalfiction #internationalbestseller

items.title: mind bending Natsume Soseki The Gate NYRB Classics Introduction by Pico Iyer
items.description: A quietly devastating novel about a humble couple exiled by their own families for marrying without consent, whose fragile peace is shattered when a debt forces a reckoning with the past. Natsume Soseki called this his favorite among all his own novels, and Haruki Murakami has cited it as the book he identifies with most strongly. The New Statesman called it a masterpiece of taste and clarity. This NYRB edition offers a new, more accurate translation than earlier versions. 4.07 stars on Goodreads. #japaneseliterature #natsumesoseki #nyrbclassics

items.title: learn spanish Pablo Neruda Twenty Love Poems and a Song of Despair Penguin Deluxe Nobel Prize Poet
items.description: Written when Neruda was only nineteen, this collection of sensual, aching love poetry launched him onto the world stage and remains one of the most celebrated poetry collections ever published. Neruda went on to win the Nobel Prize in Literature, and this book is still considered one of the most romantic and intensely personal works of poetry ever written. This Penguin Classics Deluxe Edition includes illustrations by Pablo Picasso. 4.19 stars on Goodreads. #poetry #pabloneruda #lovepoems

items.title: Social Science Benedict Anderson Imagined Communities Origins and Spread of Nationalism
items.description: The most influential book ever written on the origins of nationalism, examining what drives people to live, die, and kill for their nation. The Guardian called it sparkling, readable, and densely packed, and it remains one of the most cited works in the human sciences, translated into more than thirty languages. Essential reading for anyone interested in political theory, history, or global politics. 4.11 stars on Goodreads. #politicaltheory #nationalism #academicbooks

items.title: indian history Christophe Jaffrelot Pratinav Anil Indias First Dictatorship The Emergency
items.description: A groundbreaking, meticulously researched account of the 21 month suspension of Indian democracy under Indira Gandhi, called the best and most wide ranging account of the Emergency ever written. It exposes how Congressmen, communists, businessmen, the judiciary and the urban middle class all facilitated authoritarian rule, not just Gandhi and her son Sanjay. Winner of the Karwaan Prize. 3.75 stars on Goodreads. #indianhistory #politics #nonfiction

items.title: Can’t miss - Malcolm Gladwell David and Goliath Number One International Bestseller
items.description: An energetic, counterintuitive exploration of why and how underdogs succeed, from small class sizes to civil rights battles to disadvantages that turn into hidden strengths. The Financial Times called it Gladwell's most enjoyable book yet, a feel good extravaganza that nourishes both heart and mind. From the author of The Tipping Point, Blink, and Outliers. 3.97 stars on Goodreads. #malcolmgladwell #nonfiction #psychology

Praised by Jack Kornfield as work where the gold of Rumi pours down through Coleman's words, and remains the bestselling of all Rumi collections. 4.39 stars on Goodreads. #rumi #poetry #spirituality
